theme: Plans and bedtime: Put off, Figure out, Hit the sack...

pages.title: Put off
pages.meaning: to delay something to a later time

pages.title: Figure out
examples: I can't figure out this sum.
tip: figure it out -> 'it' in the middle

pages.title: Hit the sack
examples: I'm tired, I'll hit the sack.
He hit the sack at ten.

pages.title: Show up
pages.meaning: to arrive, often late or unexpectedly
examples: He showed up an hour late.

pages.title: Call it a day
pages.meaning: to stop working for the day
examples: We called it a day at six.
tip: Idiom: said at the end of work
